title: 20th Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamdu and Salawat) as the sitting begins.
Announcement of the day's agenda (agenda no. AJ/20/1/2026).
Resolution under Article 82(b) of the Constitution to remove Dhiggaru MP Ahmed Nazim from the post of Deputy Speaker of the People's Majlis.
Votes on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: This sitting was called mainly to consider a resolution to remove MP Ahmed Nazim from his position as Deputy Speaker of Parliament, followed by voting.
